__comment: Planted hop crown — placed by right-clicking tilled farmland with beer:hoprhizome. A non-colliding 3 m pole renders automatically (BlockEntityHopPlant); the perennial bine climbs it through the warm months, drawing the farmland's nutrient (requiredNutrient). TEMPERATURE-DRIVEN: a freeze (temp <= dormantTemp) makes it die back dormant, a thaw (temp >= coldStallTemp) regrows it. Growth/yield/maturity in BlockEntityHopPlant; tunable in 'attributes'.
